skills.name: Anthropic Agent Skills
skills.description: Official skill collection by Anthropic: document creation (docx, xlsx, pptx, pdf), artifacts and more. Good starting point and reference for building your own skills.

skills.name: Superpowers
skills.description: A composable skills library implementing a full software development methodology: brainstorming and design docs, TDD, systematic debugging, planning, subagent-driven execution, code review, and git worktree workflows.

skills.name: Impeccable
skills.description: Design guidance skill for AI coding agents that provides 23 commands (init, craft, critique, audit, polish, animate, and more) plus 59 deterministic detector rules to steer AI-generated frontend UI away from common design tells and toward more distinctive, higher-quality craft.

skills.name: Claude Code Action
skills.description: Official GitHub Action that runs Claude Code inside CI to answer questions, review pull requests, and implement code changes, activating on @claude mentions, issue assignments, or explicit automation prompts. Supports Anthropic API, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Microsoft Foundry as backends.
